Read `AGENTS.md`; require the released workload design, accepted actual plan,
data/compute permissions, evaluation protocol and bounded ML assignment/loop ledger.
Apply `ama-ml-lifecycle` and ML01-ML08 from `delivery/ai-ml-checks.md`.

submit cloud jobs, promote/deploy models or start another phase without explicit scope.
Stop at blockers or the five-total-attempt ceiling; do not reset it through retraining.
